categories.name: Fire apparatus (sales and service)
categories.terms: engine; ladder truck; aerial; tender; brush truck; pumper

categories.name: Fire equipment distributors (hose, tools, PPE, SCBA)
categories.terms: hose; nozzles; extrication; jaws of life; thermal imaging camera; tic
categories.ael_title: Hydraulic rescue tools, thermal imagers, firefighting foam

categories.name: Turnouts and PPE
categories.terms: turnouts; bunker gear; structure gear; helmets; boots; gloves
categories.note: Most turnout gear is bought through fire equipment distributors (L.N. Curtis & Sons, Municipal Emergency Services, Sea-Western, Weidner Fire); those payments are under Fire equipment distributors.
categories.ael_title: Structural firefighting garments, helmets, gloves, footwear, hoods

categories.name: SCBA and breathing air
categories.terms: air pack; breathing apparatus; air compressor; fit testing; cylinders
categories.note: Most SCBA is bought through fire equipment distributors (L.N. Curtis & Sons, Municipal Emergency Services, Sea-Western, Weidner Fire); those payments are under Fire equipment distributors.
categories.ael_title: SCBA (CBRN), PASS devices, breathing air compressors

categories.name: Wildland equipment
categories.terms: brush gear; wildland pack; chainsaw; drip torch
categories.ael_title: Wildland firefighting PPE, chainsaws and tools

categories.name: EMS equipment (monitors, stretchers, CPR devices)
categories.terms: cardiac monitor; defibrillator; aed; stretcher; gurney; cpr device; lucas
categories.ael_title: Cardiac monitors and AEDs, chest compression devices, stretchers

categories.name: Radios and communications equipment
categories.terms: portable radio; mobile radio; pager; repeater
categories.ael_title: Portable, mobile and base radios, repeaters

categories.name: Records, ePCR and CAD software
categories.terms: records management; epcr; patient care report; nfirs; neris; cad; computer aided dispatch; inspections; pre-plan
categories.ael_title: Computer-aided dispatch systems, software as a service

categories.name: Medical exams and wellness
categories.terms: physicals; annual physical; peer support; behavioral health
